change_summary: Add os.replace retry to data_paths.atomic_write_text + recover-before-delete daily-artifact orphan sweep (stale_artifact_sweep.recover_orphan_atomic_writes) wired into run.py startup; recovered orphaned quant_signals_20260627 + bracket_orders_20260627 and cleaned 17 stale temps. No strategy behavior change.
hypothesis: Daily atomic-write final rename intermittently fails on Windows (transient AV/indexer lock), leaving an orphan .tmp and no final quant_signals/earnings artifact, which silently breaks downstream ledgers/matchers (e.g. estimate_revision matcher saw no_daily_signal_match_artifacts_loaded for 2026-06-27). Add os.replace retry to data_paths.atomic_write_text plus a recover-before-delete orphan sweep for daily artifact dirs wired into run.py startup, and recover the orphaned 2026-06-27 quant_signals final.
notes: Root cause: bare os.replace final rename fails intermittently on Windows (transient lock), pipeline swallows it, leaving orphan .tmp + missing final (broke estimate_revision matcher for 06-27; same class as exp-005 manual recovery and exp-021 backtester). Fix is shared/production-safe and parity with backtester._atomic_write_json. 18/18 unit checks pass; recovery verified (match records 60->66, 06-27 finals restored, benign orders).
